modifiers.note: Oracles +25% favor at full LOS (+4 max LOS). Wiki formula gives ~+28% at full LOS for a plain Oracle; less when LOS is not full.

meta.note: Not expressed: all units +4 LOS; damaged enemy units stay visible 25 s; Sky Passages (one more per age) teleport units.

modifiers.note: ArchaicAgeOranos: Oracle AutoGatherFavor and AutoLOS ModifyRateCap +4 Absolute (25 -> 29). Not a flat multiplier: at full LOS a plain Oracle goes 3.41 -> 4.38 favor/min (+28%); the x1.25 here is an approximation.
